about:
Granite State Plastics operates from a 50,000-square-foot facility in Hudson, New Hampshire. The company has been dedicated to continuous improvement since 1969 and remains privately held, with a philosophy of reinvesting in its people and equipment.

As a full-service injection molder, GSP provides molding and assembly, plastics engineering, tooling and automation, and quality assurance. Its Hudson plant houses 31 injection molding machines ranging from 40 to 450 tons, including Class 7 and 8 cleanroom capacity. The shop offers in-house metrology with CMMs, optical comparators, and custom fixtures, and supports APQP, FAI, IQ/OQ/PQ, and PPAP validation.

The company serves automotive, medical, and military customers, delivering tight-tolerance components and managing tool transfers for onshoring or supply-chain localization.

GSP emphasizes a technically capable team, a structured tool-transfer process, and a quality management system built on ISO 13485:2016 registration and cGMP practices, positioning itself as a responsive partner that manages project timelines and costs.
